about: Popular names for passages whose words are not in the text itself (Steve, 5 November 2026: "Ok put em all in"). Each name leads straight to its Bible passages and to the older or other tellings in the library's collections; a saying people misremember leads to its real source, or to a note that it is not in the Bible. A text side names a passage by its exact reference (ref, with workId where references repeat) or by words it holds (find), and how many passages from there (count). NamedPassagesTests checks that every side resolves.
